purpose: Define delegated remote authorization as non-expanding: local owner/admin rights may be broader locally, but delegated remote access cannot silently acquire broader rights than the explicit remote delegation.

topics.name: Remote Non-Expansion
topics.purpose: Define delegated remote authorization as non-expanding: local owner/admin rights may be broader locally, but delegated remote access cannot silently acquire broader rights than the explicit remote delegation.

semantics.local_rule: Local owner may grant broader local rights according to local policy.
semantics.remote_rule: Delegated remote path is bounded by explicit remote delegation.
semantics.non_expansion_rule: Remote delegated rights are never broadened by local ownership, local group membership, transport reachability or successful authentication alone.
semantics.identity_rule: Origin identity remains explicit through the remote path.
semantics.write_rule: Remote write requires explicit delegated write authority.
semantics.composition_rule: Combining multiple remote paths does not union rights unless an explicit policy says so.
semantics.dwh_rule: Governed DWH remote path enforces remote-side rights.

invariants.rule: Identity assurance, authorization, remote delegation and activation state remain explicit and non-interchangeable.

hard_gates.condition: local ownership broadens delegated remote rights automatically
successful authentication alone grants remote operation rights
remote write occurs without explicit delegated write authority
multiple delegated paths silently union rights
origin identity lost across remote hop

references.purpose: Governed remote path enforces remote target policy.
Authentication/assurance remains separate from delegated rights.

prose.summary: Define delegated remote authorization as non-expanding: local owner/admin rights may be broader locally, but delegated remote access cannot silently acquire broader rights than the explicit remote delegation.
